{{Quote|Remember, at the time it was believed that all Jedi everywhere had died&mdash;that the Jedi Order had completely winked out. Fearing that the new Emperor would extend the same genocidal impulse to other Force-sensitive orders, Tokra Hazz sent many of the Baran Do Masters into hiding and thought about what to do next.''"<br />"''And ''what to do'' was to dig a big hole in the ground.''"<br />"''Yes.|Chara and Ben Skywalker, on the creation of the Hidden Ones|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Tokra Hazz''', later known as '''the Hidden One''', was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who was a member of the [[Baran Do]] Sages, a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was almost completely wiped out during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the subsequent [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], causing Hazz to fear that the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would eventually destroy the Baran Do as well. To avoid that fate, Hazz decided to found the [[Hidden Ones]], a secret sect of the Baran Do that hid in a [[Caverns of the Hidden One|system of caverns]] beneath Dorin's surface and were tasked with preserving the Order's knowledge. He then became the sect's first leader, taking on the title of [[the Hidden One]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Skywalker family/Legends|son]] [[Ben Skywalker]] discovered the Hidden Ones and their [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] and were told the story of Tokra Hazz by [[Chara]], a member of the sect. 

==Biography==
===The first Hidden One===
{{Quote|Tokra Hazz's intent was to recruit only those Baran Do and servants who were fully dedicated to the cause.|Chara, on Hazz|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:Barando.jpg|thumb|300px|right|Hazz was a member of the Baran Do (pictured).]]
Tokra Hazz was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. There, he joined the [[Baran Do]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and became a leading member of the Sages. He was a Baran Do Master<ref name="Outcast" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Purge date">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'' states that Tokra Hazz's creation of the [[Hidden Ones]] took place in the aftermath of the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were nearly eliminated by [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. With the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] in control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Hazz feared that the Baran Do might suffer the same fate as the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and he decided to create a secret sect of the Baran Do dedicated to preserving the order's knowledge; if the Baran Do ever were eradicated, the sect would be able to reinstate the order.<ref name="Outcast" />

Hazz traveled deep beneath the surface of Dorin, where he discovered a [[Caverns of the Hidden One|system of caverns]]. Hazz spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] drilling a long and winding tunnel to them from the surface and spent even more years expanding and modifying the [[Cave/Legends|caverns]]. The new sect, which was named the [[Hidden Ones]], was established down in the caverns, and Hazz became their first leader, taking the title of [[the Hidden One]]. Hazz decided that in order to protect the Hidden Ones' secrecy, no one could ever be allowed to leave the caverns. Hazz built the tunnel to the caverns with this rule in mind, making it too long to crawl out of and easily collapsible if someone tried to traverse it through other means.<ref name="Outcast" />

In line with Hazz's policy of secrecy, new members would have to accept that they were [[Death/Legends|dead]] to the outside [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The Baran Do tradition of the [[dying ceremony]]&mdash;a ceremony in which a Sage pretended to die and then secretly traveled down to the Caverns of the Hidden One to join the sect&mdash;was established as a way for the Sages to join Hazz's new sect. Hazz also decided to come up with a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] technique for communicating with the Baran Do on the surface as a way for reinstating the Sages if they were ever destroyed.<ref name="Outcast" /> By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the events of the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, of which ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'' is the first installment, to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].</ref> Hazz was no longer the leader of the Hidden Ones.<ref name="Outcast" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Master Koro Ziil, sensing that I might someday be suited to this existence, came to me. He swore me to secrecy and told me of the Hidden One, who then was the former Tokra Hazz.|Chara, to Luke and Ben Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ben Skywalker (pictured) was told the story of Tokra Hazz by Chara.]]
In 43.5 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;recently [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] for failing to prevent former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]&mdash;and his [[Skywalker family/Legends|son]], Jedi Knight [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to Dorin to find out more about Solo's fall to the dark side.<ref name="Outcast" />

However, [[Koro Ziil]], the [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master of the Baran Do]] who had previously trained Solo, was no longer present with the Sages at their [[Baran Do temple|temple]]. The Skywalkers eventually discovered the Hidden Ones, finding the caverns by following [[senior combat instructor]] [[Chara|Charsae Saal]], who began to go by the name Chara. The instructor explained the story of Tokra Hazz and the creation of the tunnel and the caverns. The Skywalkers eventually met with Ziil, who had recently become the sect's leader and held true to Hazz's rule of letting no one leave the caverns. When Luke eventually [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One|confronted]] Ziil and defeated him, the Hidden Ones were disbanded, and the sect's members returned to the surface.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Tokra Hazz was not so much distraught at the loss of individual life as at the loss of knowledge.|Chara, on Hazz|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Tokra Hazz was concerned first and foremost with the progression of the powers and philosophy of the Baran Do and was thus more interested in the safe-keeping of knowledge than the well-being of individual lives. He believed deeply in his cause, and after the destruction of the Jedi Order, he became paranoid that the Baran Do awaited a similar fate; he feared that all of their hard-earned wisdom in the ways of the Force would be lost. Since knowledge meant more to Hazz than life, he decided to form the Hidden Ones, forsaking life in favor of protecting the powers of the Baran Do.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|And should the rails be destroyed, the Hidden One knows a Force technique of mind-to-mind communication.''"<br />"''Telepathy.''"<br />"''Yes.|Chara and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Hazz was Force-sensitive and became one of the leading members of the Baran Do order. As one of the Hidden Ones, Hazz was capable of telepathy.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|He used tunneling equipment to dig the tunnel by which we entered. It's very long, some two hundred kilometers, circling and winding.|Chara, on Hazz|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Hazz used tunneling equipment to drill a tunnel to caverns beneath the surface of Dorin.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tokra Hazz was mentioned in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Outcast" />
